pages.text: Sosu helped his Uncle Amissah on a building site. There was a heavy bag of sand on the ground. Sosu tried to lift it. He pulled and pulled, but the bag would not move. “It is too heavy,” he said.
sentences: Sosu helped his Uncle Amissah on a building site.
There was a heavy bag of sand on the ground.
Sosu tried to lift it.
He pulled and pulled, but the bag would not move.
“It is too heavy,” he said.
pages.alt: In a tidy sunny Ghanaian yard beside stacked blocks, Sosu tugs hard with both hands on a heavy burlap sack of sand on the ground while Uncle Amissah watches kindly.

pages.text: Uncle Amissah put the bag into a wheelbarrow. “Now try to push it,” he said. Sosu held the handles, lifted a little, and the wheelbarrow rolled easily. “It feels lighter!” said Sosu.
sentences: Uncle Amissah put the bag into a wheelbarrow.
“Now try to push it,” he said.
Sosu held the handles, lifted a little, and the wheelbarrow rolled easily.
“It feels lighter!” said Sosu.
pages.alt: Sosu smiling with surprise as he easily pushes a green metal single-wheel wheelbarrow holding the sack of sand across the yard beside Uncle Amissah.

pages.text: “A wheelbarrow is a simple machine,” said Uncle Amissah. “The wheel rolls, and the handles work like a lever. Together they carry part of the load and make the work easier. Simple machines help us push, pull or lift.”
sentences: “A wheelbarrow is a simple machine,” said Uncle Amissah.
“The wheel rolls, and the handles work like a lever.
Together they carry part of the load and make the work easier.
Simple machines help us push, pull or lift.”
pages.alt: Uncle Amissah crouching beside the green wheelbarrow, pointing clearly to its front rubber wheel and two long handles while Sosu looks closely.

pages.text: Next, Uncle Amissah needed to load a drum onto a truck. He used a long, strong board as a ramp. He and two grown-up helpers rolled the drum up the slope. “A ramp is an inclined plane,” said Uncle. “It lets us raise a load with less effort.”
sentences: Next, Uncle Amissah needed to load a drum onto a truck.
He used a long, strong board as a ramp.
He and two grown-up helpers rolled the drum up the slope.
“A ramp is an inclined plane,” said Uncle.
“It lets us raise a load with less effort.”
pages.alt: Uncle Amissah and two adult workers rolling a large blue barrel smoothly up a sturdy wooden plank ramp onto the back of a flatbed pickup truck as Sosu watches from a safe distance.

pages.text: At the well, there was a rope over a grooved wheel at the top. When Sosu pulled the rope down, the bucket came up. “That is a pulley,” said Uncle. “It changes the direction of the pull.” Sosu held the rope with care and stood well back from the edge.
sentences: At the well, there was a rope over a grooved wheel at the top.
When Sosu pulled the rope down, the bucket came up.
“That is a pulley,” said Uncle.
“It changes the direction of the pull.” Sosu held the rope with care and stood well back from the edge.
pages.alt: At a safe walled compound well with a overhead wooden frame and grooved pulley wheel, Sosu stands back pulling the rope downward as a bucket rises, supervised by Uncle Amissah.

pages.text: Before they went home, Uncle checked the wheelbarrow. He oiled the wheel and cleaned off the sand. “Simple machines last longer when we look after them,” he said. “And we never lift loads that are too heavy for us. Always ask a grown-up to help.”
sentences: Before they went home, Uncle checked the wheelbarrow.
He oiled the wheel and cleaned off the sand.
“Simple machines last longer when we look after them,” he said.
“And we never lift loads that are too heavy for us.
Always ask a grown-up to help.”
pages.alt: In golden late-afternoon light, Uncle Amissah puts a drop of oil on the wheelbarrow axle while Sosu brushes dry sand off its tray with a small hand brush.

activities.question: What made the heavy bag easier to move?
What is a ramp?
options: A sloping board that helps to raise a load

activities.definition: A tool that makes work easier.

glossary.definition: A small cart with one wheel and two handles for carrying loads.
A sloping surface that joins a lower level to a higher one.
A wheel with a rope over it that helps to lift things.
